title: Quantum resonance based encryption protocol with quantum kicked top
summary: We propose a genuine quantum protocol for protecting user's data, either in a shared quantum computer or in a quantum communication system, that is not accessible even to the service provider. The protocol is based on quantum kicked top -- the dynamics of a spin system -- operating in the regime of quantum resonance. This protocol ensures perfect recovery for authorized users while making intercepted states appear mixed to eavesdroppers, with built-in tampering detection.
